scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/mecka-clash-dashboard run build && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server exec node ./build.mjs
scripts.typecheck:libs: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.start: corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/db run init-test-db && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server start
